quests.title: Ten Cents, Forty Thousand Times
quests.blurb: Everyone at Lidcombe is changing trains to go somewhere and be paid. I stay here. Ten cents a container is not a business. Ten cents a container, forty thousand times, after a full house at the ground, is a business.

steps.label: find the Return and Earn behind Lidcombe station; it is full, it is always full
two coffees before five in the morning. one of them is hers and she will not say thank you
take the shuttle out to the ground at full time, with the trolley, against the crowd
photograph the concourse after the crowd goes: that is what forty thousand people leave behind
six boys are tipping the bins for the noise it makes. explain the unit economics to them
two hundred dollars. that is two thousand containers, or it is not, and she is not your father
bring the haul back to the trolley and let her count it

quests.title: Two Hundred Metres From a Fig
quests.blurb: I gave the council an undertaking. Two hundred metres from the tree, in writing, by consent. It says nothing at all about a telephoto lens. Go and count what they've cut, and don't wave at me on the way back.

steps.label: photograph the avenue at Jubilee Park -- the stumps and the ones still standing, in one frame
get the notice on the hoarding at the Glebe Point Road end, dates and all, before it gets turned to face the wall
four residents will film you filming and put it in the group chat; discourage all four
buy a flat white on Glebe Point Road so you read as a local rather than as evidence
the same arborist had the Petersham contract in March; catch the inner west line out and see it
photograph what he left at Petersham -- that is what precedent looks like
cross back round the bay and hand her the phone

quests.title: The Monday Shelf
quests.blurb: Forty-one umbrellas on Friday, a bare shelf on Monday, eleven weeks running. Norm wants it tested properly and he can't leave the window. Take the marked board somewhere else and be back before four.

steps.label: the Eveleigh gate on Wilson Street, where the trolleys park
two flat whites off the South Eveleigh cart, 5:40 am
one stop with the board, Redfern to Macdonaldtown
photograph the board where you leave it, time showing
five hi-vis blokes who all started this morning
cover the fares yourself; the window has no budget line
four o'clock at the window; tell Norm what's on the shelf

quests.title: Somebody Signed the Slab
quests.blurb: Forty metres, exposed aggregate, screeded till dark on Saturday. Sunday morning it's got three names, a handprint and a word I won't repeat cured into it. She won't pay. I've got a hearing date and a grinder.

steps.label: photograph the driveway for the tribunal — all three names and the hand
have a word with the signatories, who live in the units behind the job
photograph the Botanic Gardens: the blossom, the red bridge, the koi. Her reference image
the ute's blocked in by her Kluger — get the train to the trade counter at Granville
two flat whites. One for Serkan, one for the bloke holding the other end of the screed
the client is filming you from the nature strip for the review. Be in the review
get the progress payment out of it, one way or the other
show Serkan the slab and settle up on Auburn Road

quests.title: Eleven Days on Shirley Road
quests.blurb: Eleven days that Commodore's sat by the war memorial and the plate comes back stolen out of Hornsby. I'm not hooking up a stolen car with a booze bus at the bottom of the hill. Go and look at it for me.

steps.label: photograph the plate on the white Commodore
settle the four blokes sitting on their own bonnets
two flat whites, one for the constable on the bus
catch the North Shore line up to Hornsby
find the bay it was lifted from, top of the car park
$120 to cover the flatbed and Dobbo's morning
tell Dobbo what the plate actually came back as

quests.title: Continuous Sporting Use
quests.blurb: There's a development application on our green. Three townhouses. The constitution says the club exists as long as it can field a side, so I need a side, and I need it photographed doing something.

steps.label: let Hughie read you the application at the bus interchange
photograph a proper cricket ground at Moore Park — the bundle needs comparable sporting amenity, and the club will crop it
bring the ringer in from Cabramatta; he bowls at the stumps and asks for the fare
an hour in the nets, which the grant application calls a high performance camp
settle four objections from the progress association at the site inspection
put $150 through the club, so the books show it trades — meat tray, raffle, whatever you like
lodge the bundle at the council chambers in Double Bay before four

quests.title: A Wet Signature, Before 4:30
quests.blurb: One fig, one footpath, three councils. Two paper objections, two counters, both shut at half four. The portal says it received them. The portal says a lot of things.

steps.label: photograph the fig on Hume Street while it is still a fig
the other residents' group has the same laminate — disagree with five of them
two flat whites on Willoughby Road; one of them is for Janet
raise the $160 lodgement charge, which is not a fee, it is a charge
south one stop, because the bell for this footpath rings in Miller Street
hand the first envelope over a counter in Miller Street and be seen doing it
back north, past the tree, to the council that owns the kerb it stands in
Victor Street, Chatswood, before the counter shuts at 4:30

quests.title: One Clean Shot of the Hercules
quests.blurb: They know my car, my hat and the exact gap in the fence I use. They don't know you. Get the tail number off that Hercules and be on the train before Polair's up.

steps.label: get to the fence line off Richmond station
one clean shot of the Hercules on the apron
the white ute first, then the blue and whites
the breatho on the Windsor Street approach
one stop: the shortest getaway in New South Wales
$140 for the shot. the forums pay cash
hand Mick the card on the East Richmond platform

quests.title: Sixty-Forty, and I'm the Sixty
quests.blurb: Ten minutes of surge left, a bus lane camera in front and a ranger behind. Take my queue — two to Edgecliff, four outside the pub, and a flat white. Sixty-forty. I'm the sixty. It's my account.

steps.label: one flat white, one sugar, from the Junction. He cannot leave the car and he has been awake since four.
photograph the Westfield boom gate that could not read his plate. The appeal form wants evidence and the evidence is inside a nine dollar car park.
the fare that is one stop. Take the train like a person and keep the difference.
four out of the Oxford Street pubs who are getting in the car whether or not they are getting in the car.
clear $160 of his queue before the surge dies. The app rounds it down and calls that a partnership.
back to Grafton Street so he can refresh the app in front of you.

quests.title: The 6:12 Goes Via the Airport
quests.blurb: Forty years I called the stops. Now a computer says 'City' and never mentions the seventeen-dollar gate at the other end. Ride the 6:12. Get done like my grandson got done. I want a witness who can afford it.

steps.label: get down into the Kogarah trench and read the indicator board. It says City. It means City the way a real estate agent means cosy
let the 6:12 take you. At Wolli Creek the line forks: left is Sydenham and free, right is the airport and it is not. Nobody announces the fork
photograph the gate that ate the money. Stavros wants it in colour, he says black and white makes it look like history
buy the only coffee open airside of the barrier, at the price of a return to Wollongong
make back the gate fee. Twice, because the gate charges you to get out of the mistake as well as into it
the Dragons lost at home, so the last one south is one loud carriage from Wolli Creek to Kogarah. Settle it down before Carlton
read the entry back to Stavros while he writes it in the book
